subject: Aurora Health — Deployment tradeoffs, region constraints & close cadence
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Health EngOps <engops@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Health — Deployment tradeoffs, region constraints & close cadence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the call last week. We're pulling together our internal decision doc and need a concise MAP and evaluation plan to choose between Hosted / Dedicated / Private for our LLM use (patient-facing summaries + clinician triage).

Key constraints:
- Primary data must remain in US for Phase 1 (HIPAA scope). EU residency may be required for Phase 2.
- Target: <150ms p99 for short prompts, sustained throughput for batch inference during nightly processing.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit logs + KMS integration required.

Can you send a mutual action plan with concrete milestones (PO, security review, POC, go-live) and a suggested evaluation checklist (latency, throughput, cost per 1M tokens) and a recommended region for Phase 1? We're aiming to finalize procurement by end of September and have a Nov 15 go-live.

Appreciate a one-pager and a call this week.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Aurora Health
[sent from phone]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Deployment tradeoffs, region constraints & close cadence

Hi Samir — thanks for the clear asks.

Quick answers up front:
- Phase 1 recommendation (based on constraints): Dedicated (US-East) for throughput + isolation; Private VPC is recommended for EU-specific residency in Phase 2. Hosted could work for fast onboarding but adds risk for strict data-residency controls.
- We'll produce a 1-page MAP + an evaluation checklist (latency, throughput, cost delta) and an SSO/KMS checklist.

I attached the draft MAP (v2) and a short timeline proposal:
- Security review & SOC doc exchange: by 2026-09-15
- PO + contract sign: target 2026-09-30
- POC (throughput/latency): 2026-10-10 — 10-24
- Staged go-live (Dedicated US-East): targeted 2026-11-15

Would you be available for a 30-min alignment call Thursday 09/03 at 10am PT? If so, I'll bring Priyom (solutions) and Laura (CS) to cover eval metrics and billing/contract milestones.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_v2.pdf (application/pdf)]

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Aurora Health — Deployment tradeoffs, region constraints & close cadence

Jordan — notes from prep for Thursday's call and a recommended eval matrix (attached).

Summary recommendations (short):
- Phase 1: Dedicated pool in us-east-1. Rationale: predictable GPU capacity for high sustained throughput during nightly batches, tenant isolation for HIPAA scope, and straightforward KMS integration.
- Phase 2 (EU): Private (VPC/on-prem or cloud VPC) for strict data residency; we can mirror model variants to eu-west-1 with cross-region replication of artifacts only.

Evaluation checklist (high level):
- Functional: correctness on clinical prompts, hallucination rate on gold set (target <3%).
- Perf: p50/p95/p99 latency for 16-token prompts (target p99 <150ms), throughput for 2k concurrent short requests, sustained token/sec for batch jobs (target >500k tokens/min).
- Cost: cost per 1M tokens across Hosted/Dedicated/Private (include infra + egress + support).
- Ops: KV cache hit rate, model warmup time, tracer/tail latency distribution, and rollback plan.
- Security: SOC 2 artifacts, KMS integration test, audit log sample, penetration test schedule.

Proposed POC scope:
1) In-region latency/throughput test (dedicated config) — 1 week
2) End-to-end HIPAA dataflow & KMS validation — 1 week
3) Cost exercise with sample workload — 3 days

Attachments: [Attachment: eval_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

I'll cover the perf test harness and sample config on the call. Karthik — please flag any contract/commit sizing notes (burst vs reserved) we should surface to Aurora before PO.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.p@aurorahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Health EngOps <engops@aurorahealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 15:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Deployment tradeoffs, region constraints & close cadence

Jordan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the call on Thursday. After internal discussion, we want to proceed with the plan you proposed: Dedicated (us-east-1) for Phase 1; start architecture work for Private/EU options in parallel for Phase 2.

Agreed milestones we can commit to now:
- Security doc exchange (SOC 2 artifacts, KMS specifics): 2026-09-15
- PO & countersigned MOU: 2026-09-30 (we've routed the MOU to procurement)
- POC window: 2026-10-10 — 2026-10-24 (Aurora will provide a representative workload & gold prompts)
- Target go-live: 2026-11-15 (Dedicated, us-east-1)

I've attached the signed MOU (scanned) for your intake. We still need a short checklist for the security questionnaire — please include an example audit log export and KMS integration steps. Also confirm billing contact and estimated commit tier so procurement can finish the PO.

Attachments: [Attachment: MOU_Aurora_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff.
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Engineering
Aurora Health
